T: Three bad bosses. One good dinner.
D: Three friends with unbearable bosses come up with a very bad plan to get rid of them.
P: Serve the snacks when the three friends start plotting at the bar.
S: Corn chips with spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, guacamole and salsa

Corn chips layered with spiced beef and black beans, melted cheddar, guacamole, sour cream, salsa and pickled jalapeños. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli powder, 3 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in a drained 400g tin black beans. Layer 300g corn chips in a baking dish with the beef and 200g grated cheddar, and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top with guacamole, 150g sour cream, 200g salsa and jalapeños.
Yeast doughnuts in cinnamon sugar, filled with raspberry jam

Soft homemade doughnuts fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and piped full of warm raspberry jam. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Add 150ml warm milk, 1 egg and 40g melted butter and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour until doubled. Roll 12 balls and prove 30 minutes more. Fry at 170C for 2 minutes a side and drain. Toss in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Poke a hole in each and pipe in 250g warmed raspberry jam.
M: Swap your boss double bacon cheeseburgers
Double beef patties, bacon and special sauce, with oven fries

Two smashed beef patties with melted cheese, crisp bacon, pickles, onion and burger sauce on a toasted milk bun, with fries. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Grill 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Stack 2 patties in each toasted bun with bacon, pickles, sliced onion and sauce.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies swirled with salted caramel

Fudgy dark chocolate brownies swirled with salted caramel and baked until just set, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time. Fold in 100g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Spread into a lined 20cm square tin. Drop 6 tbsp thick caramel sauce over the top and swirl with a knife. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes and bake at 170C for 25 to 28 minutes until just set. Cool 20 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.
K: Scotch, lemon, honey syrup and egg white shaken foamy

Scotch whisky shaken with fresh lemon, honey syrup and egg white, strained over ice with an orange twist. Stir 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp hot water and cool. For each drink, shake 60ml scotch whisky, 30ml lemon juice, 20ml honey syrup and 1 egg white in a jar without ice for 15 seconds. Add ice and shake hard for another 15 seconds. Strain into a short glass over a large ice cube. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in. Repeat for 4 drinks.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the beef and bean mix up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; reheat, layer, bake and top on the night

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion. Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer. Stir in the black beans.
Layer the corn chips in a baking dish with the beef and cheddar.
Bake at 200C until the cheese melts.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt.
Top with guacamole, sour cream, salsa and jalapenos.

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Grill the bacon until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Roll the mince into balls and smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan. Season and cook, flip, top with the sliced cheddar and cook briefly.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with bacon, pickles, onion and sauce.

veg.n: Swap your boss double black bean cheeseburgers
veg.make_ahead: Shape the black bean patties and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake the fries and fry the patties and mushrooms on the night

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve
400g cans black beans, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil with the soy, half the paprika and the maple syrup until dark and crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Mash the beans with the breadcrumbs, egg, cumin, salt and the rest of the paprika and shape into 8 thin patties.
Fry the patties in the remaining oil for 3 minutes a side, then top with the sliced cheddar to melt.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with the smoky mushrooms, pickles, onion and sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead, airtight; warm briefly in the oven before serving with ice cream

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with the butter. Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt.
Spread into a lined 20cm square tin. Drop the caramel over the top and swirl with a knife. Sprinkle with sea salt.
Bake at 170C until just set.
Cool, then serve warm with ice cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the honey syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep chilled; juice the lemons the day before and shake to order

steps.text: Stir the honey into hot water and cool to make a syrup.
Shake the whisky, lemon juice, honey syrup and egg white in a jar without ice. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake hard again, then strain into short glasses over a large ice cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.

af.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea up to 2 days ahead and make the honey syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep both chilled; shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the honey into the hot water and cool to make a syrup.
Shake 240ml of the smoked tea, the lemon juice, honey syrup and egg white in a jar without ice. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake hard again, then strain into short glasses over a large ice cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
